name: matching: Match the sampling terms below to the best description…

request.questionText: Match the sampling terms below to the best description for each:

blanks.label: Random sample
options: A sample in which every member of the population is equally likely to be included.

blanks.label: Longitudinal sample
options: A sample based on individual cases tracked over time with respect to one or more variables.

blanks.label: Cross-sectional sample
options: A sample based on various attributes of individual cases collected at a single point in time.

blanks.label: Convenience sample
options: A sample based on individual units that were not selected at random from the population of interest.

blanks.label: Census
options: A sample that comprises all cases in the population.

blanks.label: Random sample
blanks.correct: A sample in which every member of the population is equally likely to be included.

blanks.label: Longitudinal sample
blanks.correct: A sample based on individual cases tracked over time with respect to one or more variables.

blanks.label: Cross-sectional sample
blanks.correct: A sample based on various attributes of individual cases collected at a single point in time.

blanks.label: Convenience sample
blanks.correct: A sample based on individual units that were not selected at random from the population of interest.

blanks.label: Census
blanks.correct: A sample that comprises all cases in the population.
